--- title: Brand-words workflow · verbal strategy, not full brand design config: theme: base look: classic htmlLabels: false layout: dagre themeVariables: fontFamily: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif fontSize: 18px primaryColor: '#F1F5F9' primaryTextColor: '#172B4D' primaryBorderColor: '#94A3B8' lineColor: '#64748B' clusterBkg: '#F8FAFC' clusterBorder: '#CBD5E1' edgeLabelBackground: '#FFFFFF' flowchart: htmlLabels: false wrappingWidth: 480 useMaxWidth: false curve: basis nodeSpacing: 30 rankSpacing: 50 padding: 18 --- flowchart TB subgraph INTERNAL["INTERNAL MEANING"] direction TB P["1 · Prepare group material
Stories · actions · ambitions
Collect concrete examples"] A["2 · Abstract the material
Observe → interpret → compare → group
Trace every theme back to evidence"] I["3 · Choose an inner idea and words
What is true and distinctive about us?
Keep reasons and examples attached"] P --> A --> I end subgraph AUDIENCE["AUDIENCE EVIDENCE"] direction TB R["4 · Research the audience
Needs · context · language · alternatives"] E["Gather and weigh evidence
Interviews · observation · existing signals
Challenge assumptions, not just confirm them"] R --> E end I --> POS E --> POS POS["5 · Define positioning
For whom · in what context · why us?
Connect inner truth with audience relevance"] POS --> T T["6 · Transform into outward language
Explore several word and message directions
Keep each tied to the inner idea and evidence"] T --> D1["Direction A
Words + messages"] T --> D2["Direction B
Words + messages"] T --> D3["Direction C
Words + messages"] D1 & D2 & D3 --> USE USE["7 · Apply in real contexts
Try the language in actual touchpoints
Use examples, not isolated word lists"] USE --> TEST TEST["Test and learn
Authentic to us? · Credible in practice?
Meaningful and clear to the audience?"] TEST -. "refine expression" .-> T TEST -. "revisit meaning" .-> A TEST -.
